Effective Date: 14 November 2026

This Acceptable Use Policy ("Policy") sets out the behavioural standards and content rules that apply to all users of the mobile application, website and associated services operated by Fun App Ltd ("the Company").

Fun App is designed and developed to help people build friendships, discover group activities and form introductions, with the aim of reducing loneliness (collectively, "the Service").

This Policy forms an integral part of the User Agreement between you and the Company. By accessing or using the Service, you agree to comply strictly with this Policy. Capitalised terms not defined herein shall have the meaning set forth in the User Agreement.

## Core Safety Principles & Verification Rules

1.1. The Service is strictly reserved for individuals aged 18 and over. Attempting to bypass age verification, create an account on behalf of a minor or invite individuals under the age of 18 to any offline meetup, group activity or date arranged via the Service is strictly prohibited.

1.2. You must successfully complete the Company’s identity verification process before accessing social functionality. Circumnavigating or attempting to spoof any biometric liveness checks, submitting falsified government documentation or using another person’s identity documents will result in an immediate permanent ban and potential referral to law enforcement.

1.3. You may maintain only one active account. Account sharing, profile selling or transferring account access to another individual is strictly prohibited.

## Prohibited Content & Online Conduct

You are strictly prohibited from uploading, posting, messaging, or displaying any content or engaging in conduct on the Service that:

### A. Safety, Harassment, and Hate

- Harasses, stalks, threatens, intimidates, defames, or intentionally causes distress to any user, group host, or Partner Venue staff member.
- Promotes discrimination, hatred, or violence against individuals or groups based on race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation or age.
- Contains nudity, explicit sexual content, non-consensual sexual content or references to commercial sexual services (including prostitution, escort services, or sugar dating).
- Encourages, depicts, or threatens violence, terrorism or self-harm.

### B. Authenticity, Commercial Activity, and Scams

- Misrepresents your age, identity, occupation, location or relationship status.
- Solicits money, donations, financial assistance, cryptocurrency or gift cards from other users.
- Uses the Service or its messaging features for commercial advertising, multi-level marketing (MLM), survey distribution, spam or driving traffic to external commercial websites without the Company's prior written permission.

## Real-World Interactions, Group Activities & Events

Because the Service facilitates offline meetings, group hangouts and social activities, high safety and behavioural standards apply equally to real-world interactions.

3.1. You must behave respectfully, legally and civilly toward all participants during offline meetings or activities organised through the Service. Physical abuse, verbal harassment, non-consensual physical contact, unwanted sexual advances or stalking will result in immediate permanent account termination.

3.2. Users who host group activities via the Service must:

- Provide accurate and transparent descriptions of the planned activity, location and any inherent physical risks.
- Refrain from charging unauthorised, unapproved or unexpected fees to attendees.
- Ensure group events comply with local laws and safety guidelines.

3.3. While group activities may take place in licensed establishments, supplying alcohol to individuals under 18, or possessing, using or distributing illegal controlled substances at meetups organised through the Service is strictly forbidden.

## Partner Venue Rules & Loyalty Integrity

The Service partners with independent commercial establishments ("Partner Venues") to offer discounts, promotions and event locations for users.

4.1. When visiting a Partner Venue or participating in an event held by or at a Partner Venue, you must treat venue staff, security personnel and other patrons with courtesy and respect.

4.2. You must strictly comply with all rules, entry conditions, dress codes, licensing regulations and safety instructions enforced by Partner Venue management.

4.3. Misuse of Offers & Discounts:

In-app discounts and promotional vouchers are non-transferable, personal to your verified user profile and cannot be resold or exchanged for cash.

Attempting to claim Partner Venue offers through fraudulent, duplicated or unverified accounts is strictly prohibited and constitutes a material breach of this Policy.

4.4. Any abusive, aggressive or disruptive behaviour directed at Partner Venue personnel will result in the immediate revocation of access to venue benefits and potential account termination under Clause 5.

## Monitoring, Moderation & Enforcement

5.1. The Company reserves the right (but assumes no obligation) to monitor, review, flag or remove User Content or user profiles to ensure compliance with this Policy and the overall safety of the Service.

5.2. All content review mechanisms, moderation procedures, automated filtering, triage systems and enforcement actions (including warnings, feature restrictions, account suspensions, permanent bans, and device-level blocks) are carried out in accordance with the Company’s separate Content Review and Moderation Controls Policy.

5.3. Any violation of this Acceptable Use Policy constitutes a material breach of your agreement with the Company and may result in immediate administrative or disciplinary action, up to and including permanent account termination and forfeiture of active subscriptions, as detailed in the Content Review and Moderation Controls Policy.

5.4. The Company reserves the right to report illegal activities, threats of violence, hate crimes or serious offline safety threats directly to law enforcement authorities in England, Wales or other relevant jurisdictions.

## Reporting Violations & Appeals

6.1. If you encounter content, profiles or offline behaviour that violates this Policy, you should submit a report immediately using the in-app reporting tools or by contacting the Company’s safety team.

6.2. The procedures, eligible criteria and timelines for appealing any content removal, account suspension or permanent ban resulting from enforcement of this Policy are set out in the Content Review and Moderation Controls Policy.

## Contact Information

If you have questions regarding this Acceptable Use Policy or wish to report a severe safety incident, please contact the Company at:

Safety & Support Email: <support@funapp.world>\
Address: 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, United Kingdom, W1W 5PF
